description.value: Motoretta is a gelato and granita shop in Vancouver's Coal Harbour neighbourhood, part of the Kitchen Table restaurant group. It highlights BC seasonal ingredients prepared with traditional Italian techniques, offering a rotating roster of classic and inventive flavours alongside a dedicated dairy-free line. Situated steps from the Coal Harbour seawall, it is a natural mid-ride treat stop for cyclists exploring the waterfront.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (16 spaces, covered) at 84m. Total: 16 spaces.
